start_here: Say to your AI: "Make a working preview of option x00-r8-1 in /films/made-up-film from my cut render /films/made-up-film/cut.mp4, to judge timing, and say it has no grade." It runs working_preview.py and tells you where the file landed.

lists.label: Settings
lists.holds: One row per tool and scope (a person, a film, a piece or the whole account): the settings that tool reads when it runs, as JSON.

instructions: 1. Pour the two example setting rows into your own settings list (see pour) and fill the film's row.
2. Have a full render of your cut and a spec whose edit has prepend ranges; the overlay and its sound go in out-round-<n>/<option>/.

3. Say what you said in start_here. Your AI reads the row with tools:list, writes request.json with film, option and cut, and runs `python3 tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/do-work/working_preview.py /films/made-up-film/request.json` with plan true, then for real.
4. Open work-round-<n>/working/<option>.mp4 to judge timing and sound. It is never published and is not what a pick is made from.

worked_examples.title: The plan for a stitched opening cut from a render of the cut
worked_examples.ask: Show me the commands for a working preview of option x00-r8-1 from my cut render.
worked_examples.given: From tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/test/test_filmcraft_preview.py (the_working_preview_is_planned_from_the_cut), run for real with plan true on its made-up film. The spec is {"id":"x00-r8-1","edit":{"prepend":[[100.0,102.0],[103.0,104.5]],"hold":{"at":0,"seconds":1.5},"a1_mute":[[0.2,0.6]],"overlay":{"at":0},"preview":[0,10.0]}}. The AI runs `python3 tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/do-work/working_preview.py /films/made-up-film/request.json` with request.json = {"film":"/films/made-up-film","option":"x00-r8-1","cut":"/made/up/cut.mp4","plan":true,"settings":{...}}. Without cut it answers an error asking you to give cut; for an option with no edit.prepend (x05-r4-1) it answers an error saying there is no edit.prepend.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result":{"option":"x00-r8-1","preview":"/films/made-up-film/cuts/options-one/work-round-8/working/x00-r8-1.mp4","plan":[...]}}. The plan holds a mkdir of work-round-8/working and one `nice -n 10 ffmpeg` command with /made/up/cut.mp4 four times (the hold, two ranges, the film from 0:00), the ranges starting at -ss 100.01658 and 103.01958, a hold of loop=loop=35, the cut's sound muted by volume=0:enable='between(t,0.20000,0.60000)', and -t 10.01000. Nothing is written in plan mode.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
